TITLE: Sky compass
SUBTITLE: Pick any Solar System body or a bright star, then see where to look: azimuth, elevation, and live heading — with the same North calibration as the ISS compass.
NO_GEO: Location unavailable. Enter coordinates manually or allow GPS.
HEADING: Device heading
NO_SENSOR: Compass sensors unavailable: North is shown at the top. Hold the device flat and read the bearing.
NO_SENSOR_STEP1: Use a smartphone (Android or iPhone), not a desktop computer.
NO_SENSOR_STEP2: Open the app over HTTPS (secure connection).
NO_SENSOR_STEP3: On iPhone: allow motion sensor access if prompted.
NO_SENSOR_STEP4: Move the phone in a figure-8 pattern to calibrate the magnetometer.
NO_SENSOR_FALLBACK: Meanwhile, North is shown at the top — read the bearing below.
CAL_NEEDED: North not set — direction may be wrong
CAL_METHOD_MANUAL_HINT: Point the top of the phone to North
CAL_MANUAL_STEP1: Move away from metal objects and magnets.
CAL_MANUAL_STEP2: Turn so the top of the phone points to North.
CAL_MANUAL_STEP3: When the top aims at North, tap Save.
CAL_SUN_STEP1: Move away from metal objects and magnets.
CAL_SUN_STEP2: Hold the phone flat and point the top edge at the Sun.
CAL_SUN_STEP3: When the top edge aims at the Sun, tap Confirm.
CAL_SUN_NIGHT: Sun below horizon — use the GPS walk.
CAL_WALKING: Calibrating… walk in a straight line
CAL_STEP1: Move away from metal objects and magnets.
CAL_STEP2: Hold the phone in front of you, top edge forward.
CAL_STEP3: Walk ~10 steps in a straight line without turning.
CAL_MOVE_MORE: Walk a bit faster, in a straight line
CAL_DONE_AUTO: North handled by the phone sensors
CAL_SAVED: Setting saved — no need to recalibrate every time
SENSOR_LIVE_HINT: Draw a figure-8 in the air to calibrate the magnetometer, then turn: heading should follow.
EXPLAIN: Turn until the body icon points straight up, then look up by the elevation angle.
